bugs.title: status.json series.enabled not synced from production.json — root cause of 'shows as manual', missing next-part flow, and Zernio still showing on series tasks
bugs.notes: Confirmed via job jobs/manual-1787902548797/: production.json has correct series_id/part/is_final but status.json series is zeroed (enabled:false, series_id:'', part:0, is_final:false). Find where status.json is written after production.json resolves (likely Stage A workflow) and always sync status.series from plan. Verify all 3 symptoms after fix. Consider low-cost one-time backfill script for already-completed jobs. | Started investigation.

bugs.title: Deploy-failure notification — user should not be the detection mechanism for blocked deploys
bugs.notes: Deploy Bots workflow: failed bot tests silently skip Cloudflare Worker deploy with no alert. Add `if: failure()` step that calls Telegram Bot API directly with bot token from Actions secrets to notify bot owner: 'Deploy blocked: bot tests failed on commit <sha>, Workers were NOT updated. Check the Actions run: <url>'. Must not require Cloudflare-scoped secrets.
